name: region-list
title: Region list
description: Where your data can live: regions by continent with city, status, latency and compliance tags in a real, filterable table, not a map.
docs: Pass regions (a code, a city, a country, a continent, a status of available, beta or planned, latencyMs and tags) and latencyFrom, the place the latency is measured from. Chips filter by tag, show how many regions each holds and say politely how many are on screen; a tag no region carries is never offered. Use defaultTag to start on a chip, or tag and onTagChange to control it. A planned region has no latency and the row says so. On a wide block the list is a real table with headers and a caption, grouped by continent, whose columns hold their places while a chip filters; on a narrow one every region is a card with the latency written out ("about 12 ms from Amsterdam"). Add selectHref, with {code} for the region's code, to give each live region a link. Words are translated through labels and numbers follow locale.
